name: Caustic Brew
body:
School evocation [acid]; Level alchemist 1, bloodrager 1, druid/shaman 1, magus 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bit of rotten food)

EFFECT

Range 30 feet
Area 30-foot line
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You shoot out a stream of acid coating all targets in a 30-foot line. All creatures must succeed at a Reflex save or be covered in acid and take 1d4 acid damage at the beginning of their turn. At the end of each of their turns, the affected creature can attempt a Reflex save to end the effect or spend a standard action to scrape off the acid.
